items.title: Shankesh Jewellers shares list at 11% premium, beat expectations
items.description: On NSE, Shankesh Jewellers shares listed at Rs 103.30, a premium of 11.08 per cent over the offer price of Rs 93. Meanwhile, on BSE, the stock debuted at Rs 102.20, up 9.89 per cent.
